---
title: "Temperature and Humidity Data Analysis"
format: html
---


```{r}
library(vroom)
library(tidyverse)
room <- vroom("point_chart_pi-nano-01.csv") 
table <- vroom("point_chart_pi-nano-02.csv")
room <- mutate(room, 
    Date = as.POSIXlt(Timestamp)
)
table <- mutate(table, 
    Date = as.POSIXlt(Timestamp)
)
room <- room |>  
    mutate(
        Day = Date$mday,
        Hour = Date$hour,
        Min = Date$min,
        Sec = Date$sec
    )
table <- table |>  
    mutate(
        Day = Date$mday,
        Hour = Date$hour,
        Min = Date$min,
        Sec = Date$sec
    )

summary <- room |> summarize(
    mean = mean(Temperature),
    sd = sd(Temperature),
    n = n()
)

room_plot <- room |> 
    group_by(Day) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Timestamp, y = Temperature)) +
    geom_line()
table_plot <- table |> 
    group_by(Day) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Timestamp, y = Temperature)) +
    geom_line()
room_plot
table_plot

table |> 
    group_by(Day, Hour, Min) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Hour, y = Temperature)) +
    geom_line()

table |> 
    group_by(Hour) |> 
    summarize(
        mean = mean(Temperature),
        sd = sd(Temperature)
    ) |> 
    print(n = 24)
room |> 
    group_by(Hour) |> 
    summarize(
        mean = mean(Temperature),
        sd = sd(Temperature),
        max = max(Temperature)
    ) |> 
    print(n = 24)
room |> 
```
